prompts.down-left:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent hand-painted game animation sprite atlas.
Reference image role: APPROVED CHARACTER AND ART STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Recreate ONLY the bottom-left SCRAP HOUND mechanical quadruped dog in the supplied robot lineup. Do not draw the other three robots, ground, title, captions or scenery.
Subject invariants: a small low slung mechanical canine, olive-drab chipped/rusted armoured back, angular charcoal/steel canine head and long blocky muzzle, two upright pointed metal ears, red slit eyes, bronze round shoulder and hip joints, articulated metal legs, four broad segmented metal paws, short mechanical tail, two small distinct orange-red exhaust apertures on its dorsal back. No biological fur. The head is a canine head, never a humanoid helmet. Match approved dark ink outline and richly painted rust/metal texture, warm highlights, readable game silhouette. No plastic 3D toy, no vector icon.
Exact layout: LANDSCAPE 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, twelve cells on TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA. Prefer 1536x1152 output, cell384x384. Every cell contains ONE whole isolated Hound, centered at the SAME scale with all paws, ears and tail inside generous 24px transparent gutters. No grid lines, letters, numbers, shadows or ground. No black or white backdrop and no fake checkerboard painted in the image.
Camera: fixed moderately elevated game camera looking down about 30 degrees, orthographic, no lens perspective. DIRECTION SPECIFICATION BELOW overrides reference camera. All 12 cells show that SAME direction and character design, same head and body dimensions, same lighting, same scale. The action changes limb angles and posture, not the camera or anatomy. Each cell's rear feet baseline is in the lower part of the cell; use consistent body and foot registration.
Exact pose order, row-major:
row1 col1 (0) alert idle with four paws grounded; col2 (1) run stride A near front paw reaching forward, opposite rear paw driving; col3 (2) run stride B tucked legs on passing beat; col4 (3) run stride C opposite limbs reaching, distinct from1.
row2 col1 (4) Overdrive Pounce anticipation: lowers chest and bends hind legs, head sights prey, twin dorsal apertures glowing small orange; col2 (5) airborne Pounce: long forward stretch, forepaws extended and hind paws trailing, same size head/body, no huge effects; col3 (6) bite attack: neck extended and mechanical jaw slightly open showing short metal teeth, lunging forepaws; col4 (7) skid/recovery: forepaws braced forward and lowered hindquarters, no painted dust.
row3 col1 (8) impact recoil flinch; col2 (9) heavy stagger with lowered head and bent legs, dorsal vents slightly open; col3 (10) collapse into a fallen mechanical-dog pose, same mass and proportions; col4 (11) disabled dog lying still on side, red lenses dark.
Only small in-object red eye and vent apertures; NO baked glow halos, sparks, motion trails, dust, light beams or flames. Alpha is fully transparent outside the character. No severe deformation or swelling, no extra legs, no missing paws, no detached body parts, no merged neighbouring cells. No weapons.
DIRECTION SPECIFICATION: Camera sees the LEFT FRONT three-quarter view; hound points toward the BOTTOM LEFT of the screen (southwest), snout left/down, left side of torso and front of face visible. This is the same viewing direction as the bottom-left reference Hound. Keep exactly this direction across all 12 cells.
